Both pinned extensions own database-wide hnsw. A side-by-side unmodified extension installation is not a valid in-place migration plan.
Catalog inspection cannot discover arbitrary application or dynamic SQL; supplied SQL corpus is not yet converted by this inspector.
Current Neon target page was retrieved on 2026-10-10; its requested migration chapter is absent. The official historical 2024-01-23 chapter is a separate reference, not current-page conformance.
Legacy distances return architecture-sensitive float32; local metrics use compensated float64, and cosine rejects zero norms. Exact result-bit equality is not claimed.

approval_points: Retain source arrays and immutable export; retuning index parameters requires explicit review and new recall measurements.
Review maintenance-window or separate-database strategy for the database-wide hnsw access-method collision.
Review target installation/version, privileges, dependency inventory and application query changes before PostgreSQL execution.

gates.requirement: Approve new relation OID, original-name typed columns, vector parameter/operator/settings changes and retire all cached/prepared OID bindings. Backup arrays become stale after later writes; reconcile before any reverse migration.

Retain the backup table, its ordinary indexes and immutable export through an approved rollback window. Its owned sequence defaults are removed and sequence ownership is rebound to the new table. No cleanup/reverse DDL is generated.

Revalidate all source rows and PK identity, then full NULL/value/norm alignment and exact distance/business fixtures. Review IVF training/list/probe choices or HNSW retuning; evaluate ANN recall separately.

Approve each inventoried index drop and DROP EXTENSION embedding RESTRICT individually. Both extensions own database-wide hnsw. Unexpected dependencies mean stop, never CASCADE or catalog/AM renaming hacks.

Recollect the complete catalog and dependencies under write quiescence; compare canonical_json_v1 catalog and dependency hashes. Any drift requires regeneration. Preflight diagnostics do not compute the full Go catalog hash.

Verify role identity/membership, same-owner creation privileges, complete current default ACLs, storage headroom and backup access. Review table/column ACL reconstruction and retained sequence access. No permissions have been changed.

Approve the new relation OID, explicit copy/backup/archive names, all recreated constraints/indexes/ACLs, owned-sequence rebinding and prepared-statement/application reconnect. Names alone do not rebind old OIDs; prove no uncaptured external dependencies.

Approve a maintenance window with all application writes, DDL and primary-key changes paused from validation through cutover. Row locks between batches do not enforce this contract. Separate-database/branch transition is a different plan.

Verify table/extension ownership and required CREATE/USAGE/SELECT/UPDATE rights, RLS visibility, disk/WAL headroom, lock and downtime budgets; extension installation may require a provider administrator.
Verify immutable export/backup, restoration procedure, original definitions, and actual availability of embedding 0.3.6 binaries before promising old-ANN rollback.

Verify exact available and installed vector 0.8.7, extension schema, extension-owned hnsw/ivfflat, real[] casts, vector type, operators/functions/opclasses and option bounds before copy/index/application use.

unsupported: Full-table copy/swap is limited to the explicit PostgreSQL 16 ordinary-heap catalog profile; unsupported/missing contracts block all mutation proposals.
No online/batched full-table migration, arbitrary expressions, views/functions/triggers/FKs/RLS/partition/publication/security-label recreation, or post-cutover reverse migration is implemented.
No PostgreSQL/Neon connection, execution, credentials, live qualification, cleanup or CASCADE is provided. Every operational approval stays unresolved.
